why: Last move's filmstrip shows no gate at all -- just drifting closer into a wall corner with a mic stand, chair and door; we ended up in a dead-end nook, not near a gate. Current forward view confirms it: door/wall corner, no gate structure. The policy itself seems to recognize this (trust dropped 0.96->0.68) and is proposing a large ~111 deg right turn plus a small descent to reorient and search for the center gate. I have no visibility behind/right to second-guess the turn size, and this looks like the policy correcting its own excursion rather than compounding an error, so approving rather than guessing a smaller turn myself.
